|printed_game_text=<span lang="ja">相手のキャラクターが没収されたか、ロストした直後に使う。１フォース消費して自分のキャラクターの１名を復活させる。ロストデッキの中からもっとも上にあるキャラクターを１人、手札に戻すこと。</span><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-PSA-18-Face.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Kintan Strider (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text.</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Kintan-Strider-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">デジャリックのホログラムに登場する獰猛な生物で、驚異的な治癒能力を持っている。故郷のキンタンでは絶滅しているが、ハット人のギャングたちが護衛に使用している。</span>''
|translation='''Title:''' Kintan Strider.

'''Card text:''' Use immediately after an opponent's character is forfeited or lost. Spend 1 Force to revive one of your characters: return the character closest to the top of the Lost Pile to your hand.

'''Lore:''' A ferocious creature appearing in a dejarik hologram, with remarkable healing abilities. Extinct on its homeworld of Kintan, it is used for protection by Hutt gangsters.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says to revive a character and return the topmost character from the Lost Pile to hand. The English uses the term regenerate and specifies retrieving the character closest to the top of your Lost Pile.
